features: Compatible with: Canon iP2870S, MG2570S/3070S, TS207/307, TS4670S
description: Printing texts and pictures in high quality has been made easier with the Canon PG-745S Ink Cartridge, Black. The printer will not be able to run in the absence if an ink cartridge. Moreover the quality of the ink cartridge becomes very important to ensure that the printer runs smoothly and is able to print the required documents without any smudge and blurs.
